---
name: A program does not run as it should
about: Something runs differently on MIRAGE than on a real PC or another emulator
labels: compatibility
---

**The program** — its name, version, and where it can be had (a link, not the file).

**Where** — the page (DOS player, machines page, bare PC) or the tool (`tools/oasis.mjs run …`), the
browser or Node version, and the CPU profile and memory if you set them.

**What MIRAGE does** — what you see: a screenshot, the last lines of the log, the message.

**What it should do** — what a real PC, DOSBox-X, QEMU or v86 does with the same program. A
screenshot from that reference helps more than anything else.
